name: cyan-auction
description: Cyan Auction — Going Once: an offline-first, single-player IPL-auction simulator (React Native + TypeScript).

pnpm.//: Security bumps for transitive build-tooling deps. Version-scoped keys (pkg@3, pkg@4) are deliberate: two major lines of the same package coexist in this tree and each needs its own patched floor, so a single flat override would force an incompatible major on one consumer. Only bump a package that reaches the shipped Android bundle after checking its module format against its consumer's - decode-uri-component 0.5.0 is ESM-only while query-string 7 requires() it, which is why that one alert is accepted rather than pinned. See docs/SECURITY_CHECKLIST.md.
